title: Marking-Aware Sequential VaR Recalibration for Standardized Option Books
abstract: arXiv:2604.03499v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Daily Value-at-Risk (VaR) for option books requires more than an accurate quantile forecast. It first requires a precise definition of the loss target. Before any model is evaluated, the protocol must fix the book construction rule, the marking rule for the next day, the loss scale, and the information set available at forecast time. Common pipelines instead apply VaR methods to underlying returns or preconstructed book loss series, leaving these operational choices outside the statistical target. We propose a marking-aware sequential VaR recalibration framework that targets normalized book-level loss directly, restricts the forecast state to information available at forecast time, and recalibrates an upper tail VaR using only past forecast residuals. translated_title: 标准化期权账簿的标记感知顺序VaR重新校准
translated_abstract: 期权账簿的每日风险价值（VaR）不仅仅需要准确的分位数预测，首先需要精确定义损失目标。在任何模型评估之前，协议必须确定账簿构建规则、次日标记规则、损失规模以及预测时可用的信息集。常见的流程将VaR方法应用于基础资产收益或预先构建的账簿损失序列，将这些操作选择排除在统计目标之外。我们提出了一种标记感知的顺序VaR重新校准框架，该框架直接针对标准化账簿层面的损失，将预测状态限制在预测时可用的信息内，并仅使用过去的预测残差重新校准上尾VaR。在标准普尔500指数（SPX）和QQQ交易所交易基金（ETF）期权的样本外评估中，参考VaR在两个市场中对所有三个账簿均覆盖不足。顺序VaR重新校准改善了覆盖准确性。
tldr: 该论文提出一个标记感知的顺序VaR重新校准框架，直接针对标准化期权账簿损失，并利用预测残差重新校准上尾VaR，解决了传统方法中操作选择与统计目标脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a marking-aware sequential VaR recalibration framework that directly targets normalized option book loss and recalibrates upper tail VaR using past forecast residuals, addressing the disconnect between operational choices and statistical targets.
